stem.text: The Boltzmann distribution diagram shows a fixed amount of a gas at two different temperatures, $T_1$ and $T_2$.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution: number of particles with energy E against molecular energy E, two curves labelled T1 and T2 (T2 is the higher temperature, with its peak further right and lower); dashed line at the activation energy with the area to its right shaded under the T2 curve.

stem.text: Which statements correctly describe the features of this diagram?

items: The shaded area indicates the particles that have sufficient energy to react at $T_2$.
The total area under each curve is the same for both temperatures.
